cues.en: So that was a lot easier using Keras, wasn't it?
cues.zh: 使用 Keras 容易多了，對吧？

cues.en: The MNIST data set is just one type of problem that you might solve with a neural network.
cues.zh: MNIST 資料集，只是神經網路能解決的一種問題。

cues.en: It's what we call multiclass classification.
cues.zh: 我們稱為多類別分類。

cues.en: It's multiclass because the classifications we are fitting into range from the numbers zero through nine.
cues.zh: 因為分類範圍是數字零到九，所以是多類別。

cues.en: So in this case we have ten different possible classification values, and that makes this a multiclass classification problem.
cues.zh: 這裡有十種可能分類值，因此是多類別分類問題。

cues.en: Based on Keras's documentation and examples, they have general advice on how to handle different types of problems.
cues.zh: Keras 文件與範例，對如何處理不同類型問題，提供一般建議。

cues.en: Here's an example of how they suggest setting up a multiclass classification problem in general.
cues.zh: 這是它們對一般多類別分類，建議的設定範例。

cues.en: You can see here that we have two hidden layers.
cues.zh: 可以看到兩個隱藏層。

cues.en: We have an input dimension of however many features you have coming into this system.
cues.zh: 輸入維度，取決於進入系統的特徵數量。

cues.en: In this example there's 20.
cues.zh: 這個例子是 20。

cues.en: But depending on the nature of your problem there may be more or less.
cues.zh: 但依問題性質，可能更多或更少。

cues.en: It's setting up two Relu activation function layers, each with 64 neurons.
cues.zh: 設定兩層使用 ReLU 激活函數的層，每層 64 個神經元。

cues.en: Again that's something that you'd want to tune, depending on the complexity of what you're trying to achieve.
cues.zh: 同樣，需要依目標複雜程度調整。

cues.en: It's also sticking in a dropout layer to discard half of the neurons on each training step.
cues.zh: 也加入 Dropout 層，每個訓練步驟捨棄一半神經元。

cues.en: Again that's to prevent over-fitting.
cues.zh: 同樣是為了防止過度擬合。

cues.en: And at the end it's using a softmax activation to one of ten different output values.
cues.zh: 最後，使用 softmax，對應十種輸出值。

cues.en: So this is how they go about solving the MNIST problem within their own documentation.
cues.zh: 這就是文件裡解決 MNIST 問題的方式。

cues.en: They then use an SGD optimizer and a categorical crossentropy loss function.
cues.zh: 再用 SGD 最佳化器，以及 categorical_crossentropy 損失函數。

cues.en: The Keras documentation is a good resource for some general starting points on where to begin from, at least when you're tackling a specific kind of problem.
cues.zh: 針對特定種類問題，Keras 文件是尋找一般起點的好資源。

cues.en: Again the actual numbers of neurons, the number of layers, the number of inputs and outputs will vary depending on the problem that you're trying to solve, but they offer general guidelines
cues.zh: 同樣，實際神經元數、層數、輸入與輸出數量，會依問題而變，但它提供一般指引，

cues.en: on what the right loss function is to start with, or what the right optimizer to start with might be.
cues.zh: 說明可以先從哪個損失函數，或哪個最佳化器開始。

cues.en: Another type of classification problem is binary classification.
cues.zh: 另一種，是二元分類問題。

cues.en: Maybe you're trying to decide if images of people are pictures of males or females.
cues.zh: 也許要判斷人物影像，是男性還是女性。

cues.en: Maybe you're trying to decide if someone's political party is Democrat or Republican.
cues.zh: 也許要判斷某人的政黨，是民主黨還是共和黨。

cues.en: If you have an either-or sort of problem, that's what we call a binary classification problem.
cues.zh: 如果問題是二選一，就叫二元分類。

cues.en: And you can see here their recommendation is to use a sigmoid activation function at the end instead of softmax.
cues.zh: 這裡建議，最後使用 Sigmoid 激活函數，而不是 softmax。

cues.en: You don't really need the complexity of softmax if you're just trying to go between zero and one.
cues.zh: 如果只是零與一之間的選擇，不需要 softmax 的複雜性。

cues.en: Sigmoid is the activation function of choice in the case of binary classification.
cues.zh: 二元分類時，Sigmoid 是首選激活函數。

cues.en: They're also recommending the RMSprop optimizer.
cues.zh: 也建議使用 RMSprop 最佳化器。

cues.en: And the loss function in this case will be binary crossentropy in particular.
cues.zh: 損失函數，則特別使用 binary_crossentropy。

cues.en: So those are a few things that are special about doing binary classification as opposed to multiclass.
cues.zh: 以上是二元分類與多類別分類相比，幾個特別之處。

cues.en: Finally I want to talk a little bit more about using Keras with scikit-learn.
cues.zh: 最後，再多談一點 Keras 與 scikit-learn 整合。

cues.en: It makes it a lot easier to do things like cross-validation.
cues.zh: 它讓交叉驗證等事情容易得多。

cues.en: Here's a little snippet of code of how that might look.
cues.zh: 這是一小段可能的程式碼。

cues.en: This small function creates a model that can be used with scikit-learn.
cues.zh: 這個小函數，建立可供 scikit-learn 使用的模型。

cues.en: This create_model function creates our actual neural network.
cues.zh: create_model 函數，建立實際神經網路。

cues.en: We're using a sequential model, putting in a dense layer with four inputs and six neurons in that layer.
cues.zh: 使用 Sequential 模型，加入 Dense 層，四個輸入，該層有六個神經元。

cues.en: That feeds to another layer of four neurons.
cues.zh: 再送到另一層四個神經元。

cues.en: And finally it's going to a binary classifier at the end, with a sigmoid activation function.
cues.zh: 最後是二元分類器，使用 Sigmoid 激活函數。

cues.en: So we have another little example of setting up a binary classification neural network.
cues.zh: 這是另一個建立二元分類神經網路的小例子。

cues.en: We can then set up an estimator using the Keras classifier function there, and that allows us to get back an estimator that's compatible with scikit learn.
cues.zh: 再用 KerasClassifier 函數建立估計器，取得與 scikit-learn 相容的估計器。

cues.en: So you can see at the end there, we're actually passing that estimator into scikit-learn's cross_val_score function, and that will allow scikit-learn to run your neural network just like it were any other
cues.zh: 因此，最後將估計器傳給 scikit-learn 的 cross_val_score，讓它能像執行其他內建

cues.en: machine learning model built into scikit-learn.
cues.zh: 機器學習模型一樣，執行神經網路。

cues.en: That means cross_val_score can automatically train your model and then evaluate its results using k-fold cross-validation, and get you a very meaningful result for how accurate it is,
cues.zh: cross_val_score 就能自動訓練模型，透過 k 折交叉驗證評估結果，讓你得到有意義的準確程度結果，

cues.en: and for its ability to correctly predict classifications for data it's never seen before.
cues.zh: 以及它正確預測從沒看過資料分類的能力。

cues.en: So with those snippets under our belt, let's try out a more interesting example.
cues.zh: 掌握這些程式片段後，試試更有趣的例子。

cues.en: Let's finally move beyond the MNIST sample.
cues.zh: 終於要離開 MNIST 範例。

cues.en: What we'll do is try to predict the political parties of Congressmen just based on their votes in Congress, using the Keras library.
cues.zh: 我們會用 Keras 函式庫，只根據國會議員在國會的投票，預測他們的政黨。
